The '''State Data Agency of Lithuania''' ({{langx|lt|Valstybinė duomenų agentūra}}), sometimes referred  as the '''National Data Agency''', and until 2023 known as the ''Department of Statistics of Lithuania'' ({{langx|lt|Lietuvos statistikos departamentas}}), officially the ''Department of Statistics to the Government of the Republic of Lithuania'', is an institution in [[Lithuania]] which is responsible for collecting, processing, presenting and analysing [[statistics]] concerning the topics [[Economy of Lithuania|economy]], [[Demographics of Lithuania|society]] and environment, and [[governance]] regarding the state data. It is subordinate directly to the [[Government of Lithuania]]. The agency also supplies data to [[Eurostat]].

A Director General, appointed by the [[Prime Minister of Lithuania|Prime Minister]], oversees its operations. Several commissions and working groups analyze its operations and suggest improvements. An advisory body, the Statistical Council, consists of representatives from the governmental bodies, [[NGO]]s, researchers, the media, and other interested parties; the council's makeup and operations are subject to governmental regulation.

==History==
The origins of statistics collection in Lithuania can be traced back to the 16th century, with the [[1528 census of the Grand Duchy of Lithuania]].<ref name="lt-stat-history"/> An institution to collect statistics in the Republic of Lithuania was first established on 6 September 1919, as the ''General Department of Statistics''. The first [[census]] of Lithuania was carried out in 1923. The institution in its current form was [[Act of the Re-Establishment of the State of Lithuania|re-established]] on 18 April 1990 and codified by the ''Law on Statistics of the Republic of Lithuania''.<ref>{{cite web|title=Republic of Lithuania Law on Official Statistics|url=https://e-seimas.lrs.lt/portal/legalAct/lt/TAD/2e265bf02ecd11e9a505bd13c24940c9|website=Office of the Seimas of the Republic of Lithuania|date=26 April 2018|access-date=8 August 2021}}</ref> The institution became a member of the [[European Statistical System]] in 2004.

On 1 January 2023, the department was reorganized into an agency, as part of the Lithuanian Governance reform.<ref>{{cite news |title=Nuo 2023 m. sausio 1 d. Lietuvos statistikos departamentas tampa Valstybės duomenų agentūra |url=https://www.stat.gov.lt/home/-/asset_publisher/lbrXvLVHX2ln/content/--1 |access-date=23 January 2023 |publisher=Lietuvos statistikos departamentas |date=31 December 2022 |language=lt}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Governance in Lithuania |url=https://governance.lt/en/valdysena-lietuvoje/#vvi-pertvarka |publisher=Governance Coordination Centre |access-date=23 January 2023}}</ref>
